{{Quote|One of the Frigates in the convoy is easing into attack position. Assume it's an armed backup and treat it accordingly. Squadrons A-2 and A-3, move to protect that flank until the Frigate has been neutralized.|Grand Admiral Thrawn|<ref name="Dark Force Rising" />}}
'''Squadron A-3''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] that fought for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] under [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] at the [[Raid on Sarka]]. During the battle, Squadrons A-3 and [[Squadron A-2|A-2]] were ordered by Thrawn to protect his forces' flank from a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]].<ref name="Dark Force Rising" />
